from datetime import date
import calendar

def next_billing_date(start: date, months_ahead: int) -> date:
    if not isinstance(start, date):
        raise TypeError("start must be datetime.date")
    if not isinstance(months_ahead, int):
        raise TypeError("months_ahead must be int")
    total_months = start.year * 12 + start.month - 1 + months_ahead
    year = total_months // 12
    month = total_months % 12 + 1
    day = start.day
    max_day = calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]
    if day > max_day:
        raise ValueError(f"day {day} does not exist in target month {year}-{month:02d}")
    return date(year, month, day)
